_description: Trailing grid: re-centers downward when price falls below grid_lower (trail_mode=bear). Does NOT re-center upward — if price rallies above grid_upper the grid stops with realized profit. Backtested on three regimes at ±15%/30 levels: +5.0%/90d lateral 2026, +2.0% bear 2022 LUNA crash (+5.3 points vs static -3.3%), +0.1% bull run (identical to static). Suited for bear or uncertain market with expected further downside. Recalibrate grid_lower/grid_upper to ±15% of current BTC price. Capital = grid_levels × grid_order_size_usdt.

_backtest.lateral_2026: +5.0% / 90d (+20% ann) — 96% time in grid — identical to static
_backtest.bear_2022: +2.0% — 2 re-centers ($31,981 → $27,437) — exits at bounce (32% of period)
_backtest.bullrun_2024: +0.1% — 0 re-centers — identical to static (stopped at exit_high)
_backtest.key_insight: tight ±15% grid exits profitably when bear market bounces (price crosses re-centered grid_upper)
_backtest.avoid: trail=both in bear markets — accumulates BTC on every bounce, -23.9% loss
